# Assumption of Moses Chapter 4 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Latin palimpsest (Codex Ambrosianus) | **Section:** The Return, the Hasmoneans, and Antiochus

---

**4:1** Then when they return from among the nations, they will establish themselves in the land of their fathers, and the two tribes will be restored to their land.

**4:2** Then certain men will arise from among them who will hate sinners and love righteousness.

**4:3** But in those days men will arise who will call themselves priests of the Most High God; yet they will practice deceit, for great wickedness shall be among them.

**4:4** They will make a golden lamp and will build a shrine for it in a foreign place, and they will pollute the whole earth with the filthiness of their practices.

**4:5** And they will not inquire of the Lord, because their hearts are given over to wickedness.

**4:6** They will be arrogant, and they will commit iniquity and will be profane in their handling of holy things.

**4:7** And they will say: we have great sin, but we will not be judged for it.

**4:8** For they will love the glory that perishes, and they will turn to a foreign god.

**4:9** And then one from among the tribes will be raised up, a man who is strong and powerful.

**4:10** He will come and rule over Israel, and he will reign there for thirty-four years.

**4:11** Then suddenly there will arise on his right a powerful enemy, and he will come and overthrow them.

**4:12** In those days powerful kings will come and take possession of them, and will rule them for thirty-four years.

**4:13** He will make for them a building in the holy city in which they will offer to him sacrifices and will serve him with foreign customs.

**4:14** He will do evil things among them and will afflict them in many ways.

**4:15** He will place over them an overseer who will punish those who do not comply with his wicked decrees.

**4:16** And he will circumcise those who are uncircumcised and will compel those who are circumcised to be uncircumcised.

**4:17** And he will put many to death, and he will compel the survivors to follow the customs of the nations.

**4:18** Thus he will afflict them for a year and a half.
